title: Rental Reimbursement Coverage Schedule of Limits by Package
content:
Rental Reimbursement Coverage is written on six Cardinal Point packages, each named for its daily limit and its maximum for one covered loss. The coverage part provided under every package is transportation expenses.

## Schedule of limits

| Package | Daily limit (most paid for one rental day, taxes on the rental included) | Maximum for one covered loss | Most rental days paid for one covered loss | Deductible on rental benefits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement $20/$600 | USD 20.00 | USD 600.00 | 30 | USD 0 |
| Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement $25/$750 | USD 25.00 | USD 750.00 | 30 | USD 0 |
| Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement $30/$900 | USD 30.00 | USD 900.00 | 30 | USD 0 |
| Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement $40/$1,200 | USD 40.00 | USD 1200.00 | 30 | USD 0 |
| Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement $50/$1,500 | USD 50.00 | USD 1500.00 | 30 | USD 0 |
| Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement $60/$1,800 | USD 60.00 | USD 1800.00 | 30 | USD 0 |

## Terms that apply alike under every package ($20/$600, $25/$750, $30/$900, $40/$1,200, $50/$1,500, $60/$1,800)

| Term | Under every package |
|---|---|
| Coverage parts provided | Transportation expenses |
| Rental taxes and airport fees | Count within the daily limit |
| Rental charges above the daily limit | The customer pays the difference directly to the rental agency |
| Days beyond the most rental days for one covered loss, for parts delays | Not paid |
| How separate losses are capped | Each covered loss has its own maximum for one covered loss and its own most rental days |
| Rental vehicles paid at a time | Only one rental vehicle is paid at a time per covered loss |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The daily limit is an all-in figure: rental taxes and airport fees are part of the day's charge measured against it, not an addition to it.
2. The deductible on rental benefits is USD 0 under every package, so no amount is taken off a rental benefit for a deductible.
3. The 30-day figure is a ceiling on days for one covered loss; a delay in obtaining parts does not extend it under any package.
4. Each covered loss carries its own maximum and its own 30 days. Two separate covered losses are therefore measured against two separate maximums, never one shared figure.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical)

A named insured on the Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement $40/$1,200 package rents at a hypothetical charge of USD 46.00 a day, taxes and airport fees included. The day's charge exceeds the USD 40.00 daily limit by USD 6.00; that difference is the customer's, paid directly to the rental agency. On the $50/$1,500 package the same hypothetical charge lies within the USD 50.00 daily limit.
